# 经识的选择恰及所识：两段历史被每个经选择者之识的选择选得相同，恰当选择者把它们识得相同；其余交换固定时选择在识闭包之外不见；所及闭包之内、识闭包之外的终结不被选出，合起来的识选出它；伸出而抬高所识者的流被选中 / Selection through registration reaches exactly what registers: two histories are selected alike by every selection through a selector's registration exactly when the selector registers them alike; with the rest of the exchange fixed, selection is blind beyond the registration closure; an ending within the reach closure and beyond the registration closure is not selected, and pooled registration selects it; a flow that reaches beyond to raise what registers is selected

## 主张 Claim

设 W 是依存网，obs 是观察，g 是形成，t 是步。一个选择是关于水平历史的任意命题 select；它经 g 直到 t 之识，是指 g 直到 t 识得相同（Web.RegistersAlikeUpTo）的任意两段历史 select 同真同假（Web.SelectsThrough）；评分 score 经它，是指得分相等（Web.ScoresThrough）。识得相同可传递，是等价关系（Web.RegistersAlike.trans、Web.RegistersAlikeUpTo.trans）。不加前提：两段历史 l、l' 被每个经 g 之识的选择选得相同，恰当 g 直到 t 把它们识得相同（Web.selects_alike_iff）；g 的信念（Web.Belief）是经其识的选择（Web.belief_selects），所以 g 识得不同之处，有一个经其识的选择在 l 成立、在 l' 不成立（Web.separates）。经识的选择恰在不成立之处被其选择者否证（Web.SelectsThrough.refutes_iff）；到 t 为止某步的接纳是经识的选择，被观察条件的水平是经识的评分，评分的阈值是经识的选择（Web.admits_through、Web.observed_scores、Web.ScoresThrough.atLeast）；经识在更晚的步、更多的观察、否定与合取之下保持（Web.SelectsThrough.later、widen、not、and）。与 l 识得相同可判定时（命名的假设 decided），l、l' 被每个经识的评分评得相同，恰当识得相同（Web.scores_alike_iff）。一组形成合起来：每个成员都识得相同的历史被选得相同（Web.SelectsThroughAll）；同样的等价成立（Web.RegistersAlikeAll.refl、symm、trans、Web.selects_alike_all_iff、Web.separates_all）；成员的选择是合起来的选择，合起来的选择在合取下封闭（Web.SelectsThrough.all、Web.SelectsThroughAll.and）。识闭包之外的不见：在 unregistered_beyond_registration 的条件下（扣留部分后的水平 l，WithheldLevels；平衡只在 f 的识闭包成员所识的条件上逐步假设；部分的每个成员都在 f 的识闭包之外），经闭包内任一形成之识的每个选择与评分，把 W.level 与 l 选得相同、评得相同（Flow.unselected_beyond_registration、Flow.unscored_beyond_registration），成员都在闭包之内的一组合起来亦然（Flow.unselected_beyond_registration_all）；在 alike_within_registration 的假设下（两流在场者相同，起始在所识者上相同，成员只经自己之识回应），经对两流画出的识闭包内任一形成之识的每个选择，把两流的水平选得相同（Flow.unselected_beyond_registration_responsive）。后代中的份额（应用）：select 在 ms 的每个亲代的历史上成立、在 es 的每个亲代的历史上不成立，它成立的亲代至少有 a 个后代、不成立的至多 b 个，b < a，ms、es 都非空时，ms 的后代与 es 的后代之比严格大于 ms 与 es 之比（share_rises_through，即 share_rises）。见证 Clearing：经清除者之识（只识支持）的每个选择在每一步都把清除与不清除的世界选得相同，栖居者在前者中被终结、在后者中不然，“栖居者被终结”在任何一步都不经清除者之识（Clearing.unselected）；栖居者在清除者的所及闭包之内、识闭包之外，清除者不识栖息地（Clearing.dweller_within_reach）；“栖居者在第三步被接纳”经栖居者之识，分开两个世界（Clearing.selected_by_dweller）；“第三步两者都被接纳”经两者合起来的识，分开两个世界，而不经任一单独之识（Clearing.selected_pooled）。见证 Diversion：转移的流从栖居者所依存的来源取一个单位给取用者观察的存储，伸到识闭包之外的栖居者；“存储在第二步至少为一”经取用者之识，在转移的流成立、在不分流的流不成立；栖居者在转移的流中从第二步起不被支持，在不分流的流中每步被支持（Diversion.favours）；经取用者之识的每个选择把转移的流与不伸出、只给予存储的供给的流选得相同（Diversion.blind_to_source）。不用 Lean 公理。 / Let W be a web, obs an observation, g a formation and t a step. A selection is any claim select about level histories; it goes through g's registration up to t when any two histories g registers alike up to t (Web.RegistersAlikeUpTo) are both selected or both not (Web.SelectsThrough); a score goes through it when they score alike (Web.ScoresThrough). Registering alike is transitive, so an equivalence (Web.RegistersAlike.trans, Web.RegistersAlikeUpTo.trans). With no premise, two histories l, l' are selected alike by every selection through g's registration exactly when g registers them alike up to t (Web.selects_alike_iff); g's belief (Web.Belief) is such a selection (Web.belief_selects), so where g registers them apart some selection through its registration holds at l and fails at l' (Web.separates). A selection through registration is refuted by its selector exactly where it fails (Web.SelectsThrough.refutes_iff); admission at a step up to t is a selection through registration, the level of an observed condition a score through it, and a score's threshold a selection through it (Web.admits_through, Web.observed_scores, Web.ScoresThrough.atLeast); going through registration survives later steps, more observation, negation and conjunction (Web.SelectsThrough.later, widen, not, and). Where registering alike with l is decidable (the named hypothesis decided), l and l' are scored alike by every score through registration exactly when they are registered alike (Web.scores_alike_iff). For a group, histories every member registers alike are selected alike (Web.SelectsThroughAll); the same equivalence holds (Web.RegistersAlikeAll.refl, symm, trans, Web.selects_alike_all_iff, Web.separates_all); a member's selection is a group selection, and group selections are closed under conjunction (Web.SelectsThrough.all, Web.SelectsThroughAll.and). Blindness beyond the registration closure: under the conditions of unregistered_beyond_registration (l the levels with a part withheld, WithheldLevels; balance assumed only on the conditions members of f's registration closure register, at each step; every member of the part beyond f's registration closure), every selection and every score through the registration of a formation within the closure treats W.level and l alike (Flow.unselected_beyond_registration, Flow.unscored_beyond_registration), and so does every group whose members lie within the closure (Flow.unselected_beyond_registration_all); under the hypotheses of alike_within_registration (the same formations present in both flows, the same start on what is registered, members responding only through their own registration), every selection through the registration of a formation within the registration closure drawn through both flows selects the two flows' levels alike (Flow.unselected_beyond_registration_responsive). Share among descendants (an application): where select holds for the history of every parent in ms and for none in es, the parents it holds for have at least a offspring and the others at most b, b < a, and ms and es are non-empty, the offspring of ms stand to those of es strictly more than ms stands to es (share_rises_through, that is share_rises). Witness Clearing: every selection through the clearer's registration (support only) selects the cleared and the spared world alike at every step, while the dweller is ended in the first and not in the second, and that the dweller is ended goes through the clearer's registration at no step (Clearing.unselected); the dweller lies within the clearer's reach closure and beyond its registration closure, and the clearer does not register the habitat (Clearing.dweller_within_reach); the dweller's admission at the third step goes through the dweller's registration and separates the two worlds (Clearing.selected_by_dweller); both being admitted at the third step goes through the pooled registration of the two, separates the worlds, and goes through neither registration alone (Clearing.selected_pooled). Witness Diversion: the diverting flow takes a unit from the source a dweller depends on and gives it to the store the taker observes, reaching the dweller beyond the registration closure; that the store stands at least one at the second step goes through the taker's registration, holds in the diverting flow and fails in the undiverted one; the dweller is unsupported from the second step on in the diverting flow and supported at every step in the undiverted one (Diversion.favours); every selection through the taker's registration selects the diverting flow alike with a supplying flow that only gives to the store and reaches nothing beyond (Diversion.blind_to_source). No Lean axiom is used.

## 前提与对应 Hypotheses and correspondence

- 选择经识（Web.SelectsThrough、Web.ScoresThrough、Web.SelectsThroughAll）是给出的条件，写在用到它的每条定理中，不推出；选择是关于水平历史的任意命题。 / That a selection goes through registration (Web.SelectsThrough, Web.ScoresThrough, Web.SelectsThroughAll) is a supplied condition written into each theorem that uses it, never derived; a selection is any claim about level histories.
- 识闭包之外的不见另设 unregistered_beyond_registration 的条件：其余交换固定（扣留的部分，WithheldLevels）；平衡只在识闭包成员所识的条件上逐步假设（Flow.BalancesOn）；部分的每个成员都在识闭包之外。回应的形式另设 alike_within_registration 的假设：两流在场者相同、起始在所识者上相同、成员只经自己之识回应。 / Blindness beyond the registration closure further assumes the conditions of unregistered_beyond_registration: the rest of the exchange fixed (a part withheld, WithheldLevels); balance assumed only on the conditions members of the registration closure register, at each step (Flow.BalancesOn); every member of the part beyond the registration closure. The responsive form assumes the hypotheses of alike_within_registration: the same formations present in both flows, the same start on what is registered, members responding only through their own registration.
- 评分定律的逆向以“与第一段历史识得相同”的可判定性为命名的假设（decided）；选择的定律不需要判定。 / The converse of the law for scores takes the decidability of registering alike with the first history as a named hypothesis (decided); the law for selections needs no decision.
- share_rises_through：亲代的历史、后代数的下界与上界（rewarded、unrewarded）、b < a、两类亲代都在，都是给出的；传递不在其中。 / share_rises_through: the parents' histories, the lower and upper bounds on offspring (rewarded, unrewarded), b < a and both kinds of parent present are supplied; transmission is not part of it.
- 见证的结论：Clearing 的流与网（P40、P42、P49），以及 Diversion 的三个流与网。 / For the witnesses: Clearing's flows and webs (P40, P42, P49), and Diversion's three flows and webs.
- 离散的步（从第 0 步计）；自然数的水平、所需与数量。 / Discrete steps, counted from step 0; natural-number levels, needs and amounts.

## 复用与下一增量 Reuse and next delta

自身动作的缺口作为一般定理：动作只在识闭包成员都不识的条件上不同时，经其识的每个选择都看不见它；偏向伸出的一般形式：抬高所识者的部分何时必伸出识闭包之外；与传递、后代和开放（Capture 的 descent_needs_unrun）组合，陈述伸出者份额的上升；登记改变时的选择保留／损失及局部执行已由 P93 完成；P99/P103 进一步接通后果修改参考构造方法、取得新候选、实际观察使用与受支持的反复修订。任意物理原语的形成及 Capture 更一般的规则变化保留自身范围。 / The gap for one's own act as a general theorem: where an act differs only on conditions no member of the registration closure registers, every selection through that registration misses it; a general form of favouring reaching beyond: when a part raising what registers must reach beyond the registration closure; combined with transmission, descent and openness (Capture's descent_needs_unrun), the rise of the share of what reaches beyond; P93 now supplies choice preservation/loss under changing registration and a local executed reconstruction; P99/P103 further join consequence-driven reference-construction methods, acquired candidates, actual observation/use and supported recurring revision. Formation of arbitrary physical primitives and more general rule-changing capture retain their own scope.
